bullet_points: Load the observed map, halo catalog, and ground-truth maps.
Print summary statistics (RMS, min, max) for all maps and catalog fields (mass, velocity, tau) to validate against specifications.
Convert pixel indices to physical coordinates and save the processed catalog.
Generate and save a multi-panel diagnostic figure showing the observed, CMB truth, kSZ truth, and noise maps with colorbars and RMS annotations.
Construct the CMB power spectrum C_ell^CMB using the provided formula and the noise power spectrum C_ell^noise based on the 20 μK RMS.
Construct the matched filter Ψ(ell) = B(ell) / (C_ell^CMB + C_ell^noise) using the Gaussian beam B(ell).
Generate and save a diagnostic plot comparing the power spectra of the observed map, CMB truth, noise, and the matched filter transfer function.
Apply the filter to the observed map and save the resulting filtered map.
Implement the pairwise estimator τ_hat(r) on both the raw observed map and the ksz_map_truth.npy.
Calculate temperature differences ΔT_ij and velocity differences Δv_ij for all pairs.
Compute the estimator in radial bins and save the results for both maps.
Generate and save a plot comparing the pairwise estimator results from the observed map and the truth map to quantify the noise penalty.
Divide the 5,000 halos into ten equal-width bins based on log10(M500/M_sun).
Extract the mean optical depth <τ> per bin by applying the velocity-weighted cross-correlation estimator Σ(T_i * v_r,i) / Σ(v_r,i^2) at halo positions on the filtered map.
Compute the true mean τ per bin from the catalog for comparison.
Perform a linear regression in log-log space to extract the slope and normalization of the τ-M relation and save the parameters.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Mass Binning and Scaling Relation Analysis

bullet_points: Extract cutouts centered on each halo from both the filtered map and the raw observed map.
Stack the cutouts within each mass bin for both map types.
Generate a multi-panel plot showing the stacked signals (filtered vs. raw) for the lowest and highest mass bins.
Generate a plot showing the recovered τ-M scaling relation with jackknife error bars and the theoretical M^(2/3) curve.
Implement leave-one-out jackknife resampling over ~20 spatial subregions of the 10x10 deg patch.
Conduct a null test by shuffling the peculiar velocities v_r,i and re-calculating the estimator.
Save the covariance matrix, uncertainty estimates, and null test results.
Generate a plot comparing the real signal with the null test result.
Quantify the SNR as a function of the number of halos by subsampling the catalog.
Compare the SNR of the observed map against the truth kSZ map.
Generate a plot of SNR vs. number of halos with the theoretical sqrt(N) scaling overplotted.
Print the final integrated SNR values and the formulas used.
Synthesize all quantitative results, including the τ-M scaling slope, normalization, SNR values, and null test significance.
Interpret all plots generated in previous steps, referencing them by their descriptive filenames.
Provide a comprehensive discussion on the fidelity of the recovered optical depth and the effectiveness of the matched filter.
Structure the final Results section with labeled subsections: baseline validation, matched filter, pairwise estimator, mass scaling, stacking, jackknife uncertainties, and SNR analysis.
